# Max Mungari Studio

> Professional recording studio founded in 1976 in Crotone, Calabria, Italy. Operated by Massimiliano "Max" Mungari — guitarist, music producer and certified sound engineer with 25+ years of experience. Services available online worldwide and in-studio at Via Lina Merlin 1, Crotone. Official partner of Avid Sound Lab, Algam Eko and Vanguard Audio Labs.

## Services

- Mixing Professionale (Standard, Stem Mixing, Advanced Stem Mixing)
- Mastering (Standard, Stem Mastering, Advanced Stem Mastering)
- Music Production (arrangiamento, registrazione, editing, sound design, mixing e mastering)

## About Max Mungari

Massimiliano "Max" Mungari is a guitarist, music producer and sound engineer born in Crotone in 1976. Founder of Orange Records Music Label and Studio 1976. Specialised in professional Mixing & Mastering for artists across rock, pop and contemporary genres. Featured in Audiofader.it. Official endorser for Avid, Algam Eko and Vanguard Audio Labs.
